  • Method Details

    • getSuit

      public Suit getSuit()
      Returns the suit of this card.
      Returns:
      the Suit of this card (e.g. Hearts, Clubs, Diamonds, Spades)

    • getRank

      public Rank getRank()
      Returns the rank of this card.
      Returns:
      the Rank of this card (e.g. Two through Ace)

    • getValue

      public int getValue()
      Returns the numeric value of this card's rank. Two = 2, Three = 3, ..., Ace = 14.
      Returns:
      integer card value in the range [2, 14]

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object o)
      Tests whether this card is equal to another card by comparing suit and rank.
      Overrides:
      equals in class Object
      Parameters:
      o - object to compare to
      Returns:
      true if o is a Card with the same suit and rank

    • getCardImagePath

      public String getCardImagePath()
      Returns the classpath resource path used to load this card's face image. The path is built from the suit's first letter and the rank symbol defined in RANK_SYMBOLS.
      Returns:
      resource path string, e.g. "/com/example/projectpoker/Images/HA.png"

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns a human-readable description of this card.
      Overrides:
      toString in class Object
      Returns:
      string in the format "Rank of Suit", e.g. "Ace of Hearts"
